notes_for_editor: Thin: one firelookout.com page and one FFLA list line. The 2021 Burnt Peak Fire shares the peak's name; NBC Montana places it about nine miles southwest of Troy. No source ties the fire to the lookout structure, so the story says so and no lookout event is recorded for it. A search snippet from another NBC Montana article (not fetched, not cited) gives about 15 miles southwest for a fire on the peak's south face, so the two distances differ. The 1920s log cabin's fate ('still there, ruins?') is unresolved. Before expanding, look for Kootenai NF history or Western News coverage of the lookout itself.
